title: The US and Global LNG Business in 2025—Dancing Elephants
content: For many years, there has been a long-running anecdote around the energy industry that pursuing a single large, long-payout project in the middle of massive swirling market and economic forces is like trying to walk quickly through a roomful of dancing elephants—without getting stepped on.
author: Richard D. Smead
